description: Harness defines a reusable agent runtime and infrastructure policy.

apiVersion.description:
APIVersion defines the versioned schema of this representation of an object.
Servers should convert recognized schemas to the latest internal value, and
may reject unrecognized values.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#resources

kind.description:
Kind is a string value representing the REST resource this object represents.
Servers may infer this from the endpoint the client submits requests to.
Cannot be updated.
In CamelCase.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#types-kinds

spec.description: HarnessSpec defines a reusable runtime and its infrastructure policy.

byo.description: BYOHarness selects an image that implements kagent's private A2A contract.

claude.description: ClaudeHarness selects the Claude runtime adapter.

codex.description: CodexHarness selects the Codex runtime adapter.

items.description: RuntimeEnvVar configures one literal runtime environment variable.

value.description: Value is a literal value, including an empty string.

kagent.description: KagentHarness configures the kagent runtime adapter.

compaction.description:
Compaction summarizes older session events so the prompt stays small as
a conversation grows. Omitted leaves the history uncompacted.

compactionInterval.description:
CompactionInterval is the number of new user-initiated invocations that,
once fully represented in the session, triggers a sliding-window
compaction of those invocations.

eventRetentionSize.description:
EventRetentionSize is the number of most recent events that tail
retention keeps uncompacted.

overlapSize.description:
OverlapSize is the number of already-compacted invocations pulled back
into the next sliding window so consecutive summaries overlap.

summarizer.description:
Summarizer selects the model and prompt that write the summaries.
Omitted summarizes with the agent's own model and the runtime's default
prompt.

modelConfigRef.description:
ModelConfigRef references the ModelConfig (defaulting to the Harness namespace) that
writes the summaries. Omitted uses the agent's own model.

promptTemplate.description:
PromptTemplate replaces the runtime's default summarization prompt. It
must contain {conversation_history}, which the runtime replaces with the
rendered events.

tokenThreshold.description:
TokenThreshold is the prompt token count at which tail-retention
compaction summarizes the history before the next model call.

x-kubernetes-validations.message: tokenThreshold and eventRetentionSize must be specified together
at least one of the fields in [compactionInterval tokenThreshold] must be set

memory.description: Memory enables long-term memory for agents using this Harness.

modelConfigRef.description: ModelConfigRef references the embedding ModelConfig (defaulting to the Harness namespace).

ttlDays.description: TTLDays controls how many days a stored memory entry remains valid.

x-kubernetes-validations.message: modelConfigRef name must not be empty

substrate.description: RuntimeSubstratePolicy contains the Substrate policy shared by all runtime variants.

location.description: Location is the snapshot storage location used by Substrate.

workerPoolRef.description: WorkerPoolRef references a WorkerPool in the resource's namespace.

name.description:
Name of the referent.
This field is effectively required, but due to backwards compatibility is
allowed to be empty. Instances of this type with an empty value here are
almost certainly wrong.
More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/names/#names

x-kubernetes-validations.message: workerPoolRef name must not be empty

workload.description: Workload overrides the built-in runtime image and its command. BYO requires it.

args.description: Args overrides the image command arguments when set.

command.description: Command overrides the image entrypoint when set.

image.description:
Image overrides the release's built-in runtime image. BYO requires an image.
When set, it must be an OCI image reference pinned by sha256 digest.

x-kubernetes-validations.message: exactly one of the fields in [kagent codex claude byo] must be set
